text:
`sqlpipe` is a command-line tool that exports data from PostgreSQL tables to Amazon S3. The tool converts PostgreSQL rows into Parquet files and copies the files to an S3 bucket. The tool streams data in memory to reduce disk usage during large transfers. You can run `sqlpipe` as a scheduled job or as a single command.

If you need fast query speeds on object storage, `sqlpipe` formats your data for analytical engines. The tool reads table schema definitions and creates compressed Parquet files automatically. If you want to filter rows, you can add custom query parameters before the transfer starts. `sqlpipe` saves progress in a state file so that you can resume interrupted transfers.
